source.author: verg
source.text: Quis cladem illius noctis, quis funera fando explicet, aut possit lacrimis aequare labores?
source.text_original: Quis cladem illius noctis, quis funera fando / explicet, aut possit lacrimis aequare labores?
source.text_english: Who could unfold in speech the disaster of that night, who could match the sorrows with tears?
